FAQ

Questions people ask before booking

How much is it, exactly?

$30 per hour with a 3-hour minimum, so $90 for a standard clean. If your home needs more time, it's $30 for each extra hour — and we confirm the total with you before we start. The low-income Tidy is a fixed 2 hours for $60 total.

What does the low-income Tidy include?

A focused 2-hour clean at the same $30/hr: kitchen, main bathroom, floors, and main surfaces. It's for seniors (60+) and people on ODSP or OW who need the essentials kept up. Seniors don't need to show anything. If you're on ODSP or OW, just show your benefit card or letter at the door when we arrive — we look, we don't take a photo or keep a copy. No card or letter? No charge — we simply rebook the visit.

Do I need to provide supplies or a vacuum?

No. We bring all supplies and equipment. If you prefer we use your products for a specific surface (for example, a special floor cleaner), just leave them out and let us know.

How do I pay?

Cash, due when the clean is finished and before the cleaner leaves. That way you've seen the work first, and there's no "e-transfer didn't go through" problem for either side. You'll get a text confirmation of the amount received after every job.

Do I need to be home?

For the first clean, it's best if you're home at the start and for the final walk-through. For recurring cleans, many clients leave a key or code — that's arranged one-to-one when you book.

What if I need to reschedule?

Message as early as you can — ideally the day before. Life happens, and recurring clients can skip or move a visit without a fee as long as you let us know ahead of time.

What areas do you serve?

St. Catharines only for now, including Port Dalhousie, Merritton, Grantham, Glenridge, Secord Woods, and surrounding neighbourhoods. Staying local keeps travel short and the price at $30/hr.
